comment: Stage Craft- Awful professor. Unfair syllabus. Inconsistent grading with no explanation. You will fail first test then he raises everyone's grade on the second. Don't go over text book but you are heavily tested on it. Expects you to know how to do more than what you are taught.
Reed loves uncontrollably laughing at his own jokes while everyone else looks around awkwardly.

Requires lots of easy work. I don't think he gives below an A on projects that are completed. Tests are easy, and graded easily, although they cover a lot of information that wasn't always covered in class (but is in the book). Very knowledgeable and fun to be around and work with.

Reed is a different dude. He is passionate about his work and knows a lot. He knows that those who take his class are beginners and he is a very fair grader. However, doing a minumum of 23 lab hours is absolutely ludicrous. Overall, class can be cool at times. But like I said, Reed is a different dude...

Reed is a very, very good designer, and he's passionate about theatre and design, but sometimes he has a hard time teaching it.  He has a lot to give and he's very forgiving, but be prepared to work hard.  One of my favorite classes.

Reed's a good egg, a little too touchy-feely if ya know what I mean, but he's harmless. He really loves to build stages and claims that stagecraft is an art form, but no one ever really listens to him.  Also, notice that half his shirts have lighthouses on them and the other half have dogs...
